body:
#### PR description:

Fix to the `Mini2Mini`, `runTheMatrix.py` workflow addressing `PVBS_` table discrepancies.

#### PR validation:

Checked on 200 events that the `PVBS_` discrepancies mentioned above, and visible [in this webpage](https://battilan.web.cern.ch/battilan/crossPOG/MINI2MINI/PR/pr51030/MC2023_43pairs.html), disappear when running again [including this PR]().
title: [Mini2Mini] Fix modifiers applied to 2023 montecarlo workflow
